Home.site_description: Igreja da Cidade Luanda — a family of faith, hope and love, serving Luanda with the message of Christ. Believe. Belong. Become.
Home.slide1_title: A home for the whole city.
Home.slide1_text: A place to know Jesus, build genuine relationships, and live a faith that transforms.
Home.slide2_title: More than a service. A family.
Home.slide2_text: Come as you are. Find people with whom you can grow, serve, and walk.
Home.slide3_text: Practical messages, vibrant worship, and space for the whole family.

Home.expect_title: Come as you are. Feel at home.
Home.expect_text: You will be welcomed into a warm environment, with vibrant worship, a practical message, and spaces prepared for the whole family. You don't need to know anyone or know how everything works.
Home.family_title: Growing in faith can be fun too.
Home.family_text: Children find a safe, caring environment prepared for learning about Jesus in an age-appropriate way.
Home.message_title: A Word to take with you.
Home.message_text: Follow messages and moments of worship wherever you are. Keep growing all week long.

Home.aria_expect: What you will find on your first visit

SouNovo.hero_desc: Visiting a church for the first time can raise questions. We have prepared everything so you feel at home from the very first minute.
SouNovo.expect_title: A simple, genuine Sunday full of life.
SouNovo.step1_text: There is no dress code or right way to arrive. Our team will be at the door to welcome you and help with everything you need.
SouNovo.step2_text: Expect music, prayer and a practical biblical message. The gathering is vibrant, welcoming and designed for the whole family.
SouNovo.step3_text: Stay a little after the celebration. We want to hear your story, introduce you to the community and help you find your next step.
SouNovo.plan_title: Everything you need before leaving home.
SouNovo.cta_title: Would you like someone to welcome you personally?

Sobre.hero_title: A church for the city. A home for you.
Sobre.hero_desc: We are a Christian community in Luanda that helps people know Jesus, build true relationships and live a faith with impact.
Sobre.mission_title: Helping every person take their next step with God.
Sobre.mission_p1: We exist to create a community where faith is lived authentically, questions are welcome and no one has to walk alone.
Sobre.mission_p2: We are a Christian family committed to serving Luanda, welcoming people and sharing the message of Jesus with clarity and love.
Sobre.values_title: Values visible in the way we welcome, serve and grow.
Sobre.value1_text: Our faith, teaching and decisions begin and end in Jesus Christ.
Sobre.value2_text: Every story matters. We create space to belong even before understanding everything.
Sobre.value3_text: Church does not end on Sunday: we serve the city, families and the next generation.
Sobre.value4_text: We give our best because every detail can help someone find hope.

SobreSlug.equipa_body: We are a team of leaders and volunteers committed to serving God and the city of Luanda with love, integrity and excellence.
SobreSlug.conectar_body: Life is better in community. Come and meet the church on a Sunday, join a connection group and find a place where you can grow and serve.
SobreSlug.cta_title: We want to know your story too.

Ministerios.hero_title: There is a place for your gifts and your story.
Ministerios.hero_desc: Discover communities designed for every stage of life and practical opportunities to serve people.
Ministerios.item1_text: A safe, joyful and biblical environment where children discover they are loved by God.
Ministerios.item2_text: Friendships, honest conversations and experiences that help a new generation live their own faith.
Ministerios.item3_text: Gatherings of care, growth and encouragement for every season of life.
Ministerios.item4_text: Relationships that challenge men to lead, serve and grow with integrity.
Ministerios.item5_text: Talents placed at the service of the church to create beautiful, clear gatherings centred on Jesus.
Ministerios.item6_text: Faith turned into action through initiatives that care for the real needs of the city.

Criancas.hero_title: A great place for the little ones.
Criancas.hero_desc: While adults take part in the celebration, children learn about God in a safe, creative environment full of joy.
Criancas.item1_text: Supervised check-in and a trained team to care for every child.
Criancas.item2_text: Bible stories, music and activities suited to each age.
Criancas.item3_text: Warm volunteers so parents and children feel at ease.

Eventos.hero_desc: Celebrate, grow and build relationships during the week. See the upcoming gatherings of our community.

Grupos.hero_title: Life is better when we do not walk alone.
Grupos.hero_desc: Groups are small gatherings in different areas of Luanda to build friendships, pray and grow in faith.
Grupos.section_title: Real people. Honest conversations. Faith for the week.
Grupos.section_text: Tell us your area, stage of life and availability. Our team will help you find a group where you can feel at home.

Assistir.hero_title: A message to take with you.
Assistir.hero_desc: Follow our celebrations and revisit messages that help you live a practical faith during the week.
Assistir.card_eyebrow: Coming soon on our official channels
Assistir.card_text: Join us in person at 08:00 or 10:30. Broadcasts and messages will be published on YouTube.

Doar.hero_title: Giving is taking part in transformation.
Doar.hero_desc: Every contribution supports caring for people, growing families and reaching our city.
Doar.section_text: To protect your data, giving methods are confirmed directly with the church team. We never ask for passwords or personal codes.

Contacto.hero_desc: Talk to the team to plan a visit, find a group, request prayer or receive more information.

SitemapPage.meta_description: All pages of the Igreja da Cidade Luanda website in one place.

InfoSlug.oracao_body: Our prayer team is ready to walk with you. Send your request through the official church contact; we handle it with respect and discretion.
InfoSlug.batismo_body: Baptism is a public declaration of faith in Jesus. If you have decided to take this step, talk to our team to learn about the next preparation meeting.
InfoSlug.casamento_body: We offer pastoral guidance for couples who want to strengthen communication, faith and family life. The first step is a confidential conversation with the team.

Privacidade.meta_description: How Igreja da Cidade Luanda collects, uses and protects your data — testimonies, contacts and cookies.
Privacidade.title: Privacy Policy
Privacidade.intro: We respect your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect on this site, how we use it and what rights you have over it.
Privacidade.sec1_h: Who is responsible for your data
Privacidade.sec1_p1: The data controller is Igreja da Cidade Luanda, in Luanda, Angola. For any privacy question — including access, correction or deletion — write to contacto@igrejadacidadeluanda.org, which is also the contact of the data protection officer.
Privacidade.sec2_p1: We collect only the data you send us voluntarily:
Privacidade.sec2_b1: Testimony form: full name, phone and email (optional), story, approximate date, category, photo or video (optional), contact preference and publication consent.
Privacidade.sec2_b2: Contact and request forms: name, email and message.
Privacidade.sec2_b3: Minimum technical operating data (for example, admin session and security logs).
Privacidade.sec3_b1: To answer your requests and messages.
Privacidade.sec3_b2: To receive, moderate and — only with your express consent — publish testimonies.
Privacidade.sec3_b3: To manage the activities and communication of the church.
Privacidade.sec3_b4: To keep the site secure and prevent abuse.
Privacidade.sec4_p1: When submitting a testimony you explicitly choose between authorising publication on the official channels of the church or allowing internal use only. Nothing is published without that choice.
Privacidade.sec4_p2: Even with authorisation, every testimony goes through moderation: only what is approved becomes publicly visible. You may withdraw consent at any time via the email above.
Privacidade.sec5_p1: We do not sell or share your data with third parties for marketing. Data is stored on our database platform (Convex, on secure cloud infrastructure outside Angola). By submitting the form, you consent to this international transfer, necessary to provide the service; you may request information about the safeguards applied via the email above.
Privacidade.sec5_p2: Attachments remain private and only become accessible after approval and publication consent.
Privacidade.sec6_p1: We keep data only for as long as necessary for the purposes described. Rejected testimonies are automatically deleted, with their attachments, 180 days after the decision. If you request deletion, we remove your personal data and attachments within a reasonable time, except where the law requires otherwise.
Privacidade.sec7_p1: You have the right to request, free of charge:
Privacidade.sec7_b1: Access to the data we hold about you.
Privacidade.sec7_b2: Correction of incorrect or outdated data.
Privacidade.sec7_b3: Deletion of your data and attachments.
Privacidade.sec8_p1: The form requires confirmation that you are 18 or older, or that your parent or guardian authorises the submission. Testimonies from minors without that authorisation are removed during moderation.
Privacidade.sec9_p1: We explain in detail in our Cookie Policy which cookies we use and how you can manage them.
Privacidade.sec10_p1: We may update this page when needed. The date at the top always shows the latest version.

Termos.meta_description: Rules for using the Igreja da Cidade Luanda website, including testimony submissions.
Termos.title: Terms of Use
Termos.intro: Welcome to the Igreja da Cidade Luanda website. By browsing here, you accept these simple rules.
Termos.sec1_p1: This site presents the church, its ministries, events and activities, and allows the voluntary submission of requests and testimonies.
Termos.sec2_b1: Use the site respectfully and truthfully.
Termos.sec2_b2: Do not submit offensive, false, illegal content or content that violates the rights of others.
Termos.sec2_b3: Do not try to disrupt the operation of the site.
Termos.sec3_b1: You confirm that the information submitted is true.
Termos.sec3_b2: You confirm that you have authorisation for any photo or video shared (including third parties who appear in them).
Termos.sec3_b3: By authorising publication, you grant the church a free licence to publish the testimony on its official channels.
Termos.sec3_b4: All testimonies go through moderation; submission does not guarantee publication.
Termos.sec4_p1: Published content (schedules, events, messages) is for information and may be updated without notice. If in doubt, confirm through the official contacts.
Termos.sec5_p1: Information about contributions is for information only. Any payment is processed by secure partners, with their own terms.
Termos.sec6_p1: Texts, images and visual identity of this site belong to the church or their authors. You may share links, but not copy content in bulk without permission.
Termos.sec7_p1: The site links to external services (for example, YouTube and social media), which have their own rules and policies.
Termos.sec8_p1: We do our best to keep the site accurate and available, but we do not guarantee the complete absence of errors or interruptions.
Termos.sec9_p1: Questions about these terms? Write to contacto@igrejadacidadeluanda.org.

Cookies.meta_description: Which cookies the Igreja da Cidade Luanda website uses and how you can manage them in your browser.
Cookies.title: Cookie Policy
Cookies.intro: Cookies are small files the browser stores so the site works well. We use as few as possible.
Cookies.sec1_p1: Without these, parts of the site do not work:
Cookies.sec1_b1: Management area session (rccg_admin): keeps the administrator signed in; it only exists for those who enter management.
Cookies.sec1_b2: Security and load balancing of the hosting platform.
Cookies.sec2_p1: At the moment we do not embed external content on our pages (YouTube videos are only links that open on YouTube). If we embed videos or maps in the future, we will update this page first.
Cookies.sec2_b1: Links to social media and YouTube (they only set cookies if you visit them).
Cookies.sec3_b1: We do not use advertising cookies nor sell browsing data.
Cookies.sec3_b2: At the moment we do not use analytics tools.
Cookies.sec4_p1: You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge). Note that blocking necessary cookies may prevent form submissions and access to management.
Cookies.sec5_p1: Questions? Write to contacto@igrejadacidadeluanda.org or read the Privacy Policy.
